summary: Ferrari N.V. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release detailing daily purchases under its Third Tranche buyback, part of an approximately EUR 3.5bn multi-year program expected through 2030. From September 14-18, 2026, Ferrari repurchased 53,717 common shares for EUR 19.06m, split between Euronext Milan and NYSE, at an average EUR 354.90 per share. Cumulative Third Tranche consideration reached EUR 32.93m and USD 16.0m, with 1,722,869 treasury shares, 0.97% of common shares, held as of September 18. Watch execution pace versus the EUR 250m tranche cap.
